title: ClipCraft 1.0 beta
summary: Capture, annotate and explain in one local Windows workspace: editable image guides, multitrack video, narration and live audio effects.

Image capture and editing: Region, window, fullscreen, Region-only manual/automatic scrolling, and editable Step by Step guides.
Rich text, Lines, shapes/callouts, Icons, Steps, Penlighter, Obfuscate, crop and editable frames.
Multipage Page Setup, reusable templates/presets, OCR and local Library organization.
Focus windows combine outside blur/darken while retaining editable geometry and upper annotations.
Video and narration: Screen/window video with microphone and system audio, optional webcam narration and linked clips.
Multiple media/annotation tracks, trim/split/link, fades, motion presets, editable Zoom/Focus and frame styling.
Per-clip/per-track EQ, compression, clarity, de-essing, leveling and limiting with local Analyze Voice suggestions.
Beta finishing repairs: Focus movement reuses its underlying image instead of rebuilding the full canvas.
Reduced-resolution framed crossfades no longer suppress the whole preview; upper annotations remain visible.
Focus appears in video Insert; capture tray toggles remain open, including Open ClipCraft after capture.
Fresh Libraries default to 1,000 items / 16 GB. Clean MSI/ZIP packages include no personal projects or settings.

limitations: Unsigned Windows 10/11 x64 beta. Old development project formats are unsupported; back up work before updating.
Framed crossfades involving rotation, transparency, different frames or fit-mode can still preview less smoothly. Export uses the full-resolution compositor.

Video redactions do not automatically track moving information. Inspect every frame; editable projects retain original content and must not be shared as sanitized documents. Focus is not a privacy tool; blur/pixelation may leave information inferable.
Scrolling capture is Region-only; exclude fixed headers/footers. Automatic cursor choreography and tracked video redaction are deferred.
Complex effects and high-resolution webcam previews can be slower on some systems. Device/driver behavior varies.
PDF text is outlined, not searchable. No automatic updater. MSI extraction/table validation is checked; clean-machine installation across Windows configurations remains a review limitation.
